meta.name: understand-dashboard
meta.description: Launch the interactive web dashboard to visualize a codebase's knowledge graph

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 可视化代码库知识图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要直观浏览代码库的结构和依赖关系。
copy.tagline_en: Visualize your codebase's knowledge graph interactively.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to explore your codebase's structure and dependencies visually.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在本地启动一个网页仪表盘,把项目的代码知识图谱可视化出来,并把带 token 的访问链接报告给你。仪表盘在后台运行,浏览器会自动打开。
howto.when: 当你要求可视化或查看某个代码库的知识图谱,或运行 /understand-dashboard 时接管;项目里需已有 .understand-anything/knowledge-graph.json,没有则提示先运行 /understand。

say.text: 为当前项目启动知识图谱仪表盘
say.note: 会起本地 Vite 服务并给出带 token 的网址
查看指定项目目录的知识图谱

say.text: 把知识图谱数据在浏览器里打开
say.note: 仪表盘在后台运行,Ctrl+C 可停止

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude launches a local web dashboard that visualizes the project's code knowledge graph and reports a tokenized URL. It runs in the background and the browser opens automatically.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to visualize a codebase's knowledge graph, or run /understand-dashboard. The project needs .understand-anything/knowledge-graph.json, else it tells you to run /understand first.

say_en.text: Start the knowledge graph dashboard for this project
say_en.note: Runs a local Vite server and returns a tokenized URL
View the knowledge graph for a given project directory

say_en.text: Open the knowledge graph in my browser
say_en.note: Dashboard runs in background; Ctrl+C stops it
